title: Core tests over a platform stand-in must use the shape each OS really reports
rule: When fm-core maps what a FontActivator (or another fm-platform trait) reports back to its own records, and one OS reports a different shape than the mock (Linux fontconfig lists the app's symlink, i.e. the registration handle, not the font file path), add a core test with a stand-in that reports that OS's shape. A core branch that only one OS reaches is untested when every core test uses the mock's shape, and a regression there breaks one platform with CI green.
rationale: E6.7 (#80): clashes() mapped the app's own Linux link (handle) to its face, but every core test used MockActivator, which reports the file path; deleting the mapping broke the Conflicts view on Linux with all tests green.
